kubejs.ponder.agronomic.header: How to Use the Agronomic Sourcelink
kubejs.ponder.agronomic.text_4: (It can be anything that gives growth ticks)
kubejs.ponder.agronomic.text_5: It will produce source when something grows near it
kubejs.ponder.agronomic.text_6: If there isn't a storage block available source will be stored in within.
kubejs.ponder.enchanting.header: How to Use the Enchanting Apparatus
kubejs.ponder.enchanting.text_1: Arcane Core is required below the Enchanting Apparatus for multiblock to work.
kubejs.ponder.enchanting.text_2: Unlike the Imbuement Chamber, Enchanting Apparatus absolutely needs outside assistance for source.
kubejs.ponder.enchanting.text_3: Unlike the Imbuement Chamber, Enchanting Apparatus can be arranged in various different ways as long as it's within 3 blocks.
kubejs.ponder.imbuement.header: How to Use an Imbuement Chamber
kubejs.ponder.imbuement.text_3: Although it can function without it, the rate is very slow.
kubejs.ponder.imbuement.text_5: It stores Source (mana) for the imbuement chamber.
kubejs.ponder.imbuement.text_6: These are pedestals, you first place items on it then place the final item in the imbuement chamber to craft.
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_2: It can store and retrieve items from a linked inventories.
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_3: Here's an example of how to use it
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_4: First use a bookwyrm charm on the lectern
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_5: You can now link 5 inventories per Bookwyrm
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_6: Use the dominion wand to link inventories to the bookwyrm
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_7: Then select the inventory you want to link
kubejs.ponder.lectern.text_8: You can now access the chest inventory from the lectern.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.header: How to Use the Mycelial Sourcelink
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_3: It produces source when there is a potion jar with potion in it nearby.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_4: It can use any potion but it produces more source with complex potions.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_5: If there isn't a storage block available source will be stored in within.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_6: Source Berries are far more worth opposed to other to foods.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_7: If there isn't a storage block available source will be stored in within.
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_8: It also changes the Envinronment! If there's dirt under it, it will make it into mycelium
kubejs.ponder.mycelial.text_9: Then if there's vacant space on top of mycelium it will grow mushrooms
kubejs.ponder.oculus.text_2: It can be used as a security camera or remote magic casting
kubejs.ponder.oculus.text_3: Here's an example of how to use it
kubejs.ponder.oculus.text_4: The scryer's oculus will show the view of the pedestal with the scroll on it.
kubejs.ponder.oculus.text_5: You can move the view with WASD keys, spell will be cast from the scry crystal's aim.
kubejs.ponder.relay.text_2: It can transfer source to other sourcelinks or storage blocks within 30 blocks.
kubejs.ponder.relay.text_3: Here's an example of how to use it
kubejs.ponder.relay.text_4: First select the input with dominion wand
kubejs.ponder.relay.text_6: Time to send the source, select the relay again
kubejs.ponder.relay.text_8: The relay will transfer source from the input to the output.
kubejs.ponder.rituals.header: How to Use the Ritual Brazier
kubejs.ponder.rituals.text_2: Here's an example on how to use it.
kubejs.ponder.rituals.text_3: First activate it with a tablet of your choice.
kubejs.ponder.rituals.text_4: In this state, brazier does not spend any mana until it's activated by right clicking again.
kubejs.ponder.rituals.text_5: You may want to toss or apply items that may be needed for some rituals Eg. Wilden Chimera
kubejs.ponder.rituals.text_6: If you have completed your preparation state you may start the ritual now.
kubejs.ponder.source_jar.text_2: To store Source in it, You need any kind of working sourcelink near it.
kubejs.ponder.source_jar.text_3: We'll talk about routing in another scene.
kubejs.ponder.source_jar.text_4: Here are some examples of sourcelinks
kubejs.ponder.source_jar.text_5: Sourcelinks automatically transfer source they produce to nearby jars.
kubejs.ponder.vitalic.header: How to Use the Vitalic Sourcelink
kubejs.ponder.vitalic.text_5: It will produce source when animals bred near it
kubejs.ponder.vitalic.text_6: It also produces source when animals grow near it
kubejs.ponder.vitalic.text_7: If there isn't a storage block available source will be stored in within.
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.header: How to Use the Volcanic Sourcelink
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_3: It produces source when there is burnable items.
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_4: The item also can be on a arcane pedestal
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_5: It can burn any burnable items but it produces more source with items that have higher burn time.
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_6: If there isn't a storage block available source will be stored in within.
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_7: It also changes the Envinronment! If there's stone under it, it will make it into magma blocks
kubejs.ponder.volcanic.text_8: Then turn magma blocks into lava blocks
